title: Armchair Racing version 2.0 is free in the browser...
author: Harlan_42
selftext:
Experience all the action of a full event as the coach.  Set the car up and pick a pit strategy.  Coach the driver on race strategy and power points.  Then watch it happen with knowing you can call in changes.  The question is can you get the team to victory lane...

Started this work the beginning of October converting the lane racing to slot racing to get a much better-looking race.  Cars are smoother in slots and lane change is just shifting between lines.  Race has real pit stops and even cautions if you want them.

Give it a try, let me know what you think or just feedback, thanks.  [http://www.stockcarjr.com](http://www.stockcarjr.com)   
add the /?preview=true to see the debug screen on landscape.
